title: senecio jacksonii subsp. caryophyllus
intro: Senecio jacksonii subsp. caryophyllus, commonly known as Blue String of Hearts or Blue Dragon Blood, is a succulent plant species in the Asteraceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe wounds, reduce swelling, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Senecio jacksonii subsp. caryophyllus include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and acting as an anti-hemorrhagic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
